## History

Katie Maurice is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her early childhood. She served as Anne's imagined companion while living in her previous foster home, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) would speak to her reflection in a glass bookcase. Although she does not physically appear in the events at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fondly remembers her as a comforting presence from her past.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's imaginary friend, whom [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees reflected in the glass panel of a bookcase door. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) relies on Katie as a comforting, sympathetic confidante to whom she can speak and share her feelings. The relationship is entirely a product of Anne's vivid imagination during her lonely childhood.

- Friend of — imaginary friend reflected in a bookcase door  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)</sub>
